hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\.cs"'; then FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '"file_path":\s*"[^"]+\.cs"' | sed 's/.*"\(.*\)"/\1/'); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then dotnet csharpier "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "CSharpier not installed. Run: dotnet tool install -g csharpier"; fi; fi
